sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决当今世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最迫切的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这全都是该大学致力于提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: You may not want to waste energy or burn fossil fuels, but the deck is stacked against you.
sentences.zh: 你可能不想浪费能量或燃烧化石燃料，但局势对你极为不利。

sentences.en: Everything is designed to just use more and more fuel.
sentences.zh: 一切的设计都在促使人们消耗越来越多的燃料。

sentences.en: And as you'll see, Lisa Marginelli argues that designed might not be the right word, but let's just say designed for now.
sentences.zh: 正如你将看到的，丽莎·玛吉内利认为“设计”这个词可能并不贴切，不过目前我们就先这么叫吧。

sentences.en: My name is Lisa Marginelli, and I wrote a book called Oil on the Brain, Petroleum's Long Strange Trip to Your Tank.
sentences.zh: 我叫丽莎·玛吉内利，我写了一本书，叫做《脑海中的石油：石油通往你油箱的漫长而奇异的旅程》。

sentences.en: First, a metaphor.
sentences.zh: 首先，打个比方。

sentences.en: We are on a tugboat.
sentences.zh: 我们在一艘拖船上。

sentences.en: A couple months ago, I was at a tugboat race, and we were looking at an old tugboat from when they used to be powered by coal.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我去参加了一场拖船比赛，我们看到了一艘过去靠燃煤驱动的老式拖船。

sentences.en: And it was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它美极了。

sentences.en: It was shaped like a canoe on the bottom.
sentences.zh: 它的底部形状就像独木舟。

sentences.en: And the house on top was rounded and aerodynamic.
sentences.zh: 顶部的船舱是圆润且符合空气动力学的。

sentences.en: Just like it is in the Popeye cartoons.
sentences.zh: 就像大力水手动画片里那样。

sentences.en: It was gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 它太漂亮了。

sentences.en: It was all very streamlined to slip through the water and through the air on top.
sentences.zh: 为了在水中划过、在空中减少阻力，它整体非常流线型。

sentences.en: But there's also a newer diesel tugboat.
sentences.zh: 但旁边还有一艘较新的柴油拖船。

sentences.en: And the hull is relatively squarish.
sentences.zh: 它的船体相对比较方正。

sentences.en: I mean, it's shaped to go through the water, but things are not scooped the way they were in the other one.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它的形状是为了在水中航行，但没有像另一艘船那样做成挖空的设计。

sentences.en: And the top is just straight, flat pieces of steel.
sentences.zh: 顶部只是直的、扁平的钢板。

sentences.en: They don't even bother to shape them.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至懒得去塑形。

sentences.en: They just skimp on all the corners.
sentences.zh: 在所有的拐角处他们都偷工减料了。

sentences.en: And the reason is, is that when you have a coal-fired tugboat, every bit of coal that you have to put on that tugboat has to convert to power.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，当你拥有一艘燃煤拖船时，你船上的每一点煤都必须转化为动力。

sentences.en: And you want to reduce the amount of extra fuel that you need to have there.
sentences.zh: 你希望减少所需额外燃料的数量。

sentences.en: With diesel fuel, it's very easy.
sentences.zh: 而使用柴油就很简单了。

sentences.en: It's very plentiful now.
sentences.zh: 现在它非常充足。

sentences.en: It's much easier to just design the tugboat, to use more fuel, to waste fuel essentially,
sentences.zh: 设计拖船时倾向于使用更多燃料、本质上是在浪费燃料，要比……

sentences.en: than to shape the steel and design that tugboat to use less fuel.
sentences.zh: 塑形钢材并将拖船设计成消耗更少燃料的样子要容易得多。

sentences.en: So fuel is our expendable in our economy right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，燃料在我们目前的经济中是可消耗品。

sentences.en: And the whole world is designed as a big diesel square-bottomed tugboat.
sentences.zh: 整个世界的设计就像是一艘大型的、底部方方的柴油拖船。

sentences.en: The biggest waste of energy is the hull system.
sentences.zh: 能量最大的浪费来自于船体系统。

sentences.en: And the most wasteful component of that whole system in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而在美国整个系统中，最浪费的环节

sentences.en: is the way we drive to and from work.
sentences.zh: 就是我们开车上下班的方式。

sentences.en: The whole process of selling mortgages and selling houses over the last 15 years or so
sentences.zh: 过去15年左右销售抵押贷款和房屋的整个过程

sentences.en: was based on this concept of drive till you qualify.
sentences.zh: 都基于“开到你能买得起房的地方为止”这一概念。

sentences.en: So you drove as far out in the countryside as you could stand
sentences.zh: 因此，你会尽可能远地开到郊区

sentences.en: to the place where you could get a decent rate on a mortgage
sentences.zh: 去寻找那个能获得体面抵押贷款利率

sentences.en: and a house with a low enough down payment that you could make that payment.
sentences.zh: 以及首付低到你能还得起的地方买房。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you'd get more square footage in your house.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你的房子也能获得更大的面积。

sentences.en: And what supported that was that you were going to drive further to get into the city to do your job.
sentences.zh: 支撑这一点的逻辑是，你将开车更远的距离进城去上班。

sentences.en: And then what supported that was that there were discounts on really big cars.
sentences.zh: 而支撑这一点的则是，超大型汽车有很大的折扣。

sentences.en: So if you'd been making that trip in a small car, you might have felt a little bit unsafe,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你开着一辆小车进行这样的长途旅行，你可能会觉得有点不安全，

sentences.en: but you could buy this like palatial car at great discount.
sentences.zh: 但你可以打折买下一辆像宫殿一样大的汽车。

sentences.en: And those big cars have horrible gas mileage.
sentences.zh: 而那些大车油耗极高。

sentences.en: But that's not all.
sentences.zh: 但还远不止于此。

sentences.en: Everything along the way acts to burn more gas.
sentences.zh: 沿途的每件事都在促使人们燃烧更多汽油。

sentences.en: Just stopping at a stoplight uses an enormous amount of energy.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是在红绿灯前停一下，就会消耗大量的能量。

sentences.en: But it's not just the obstacles.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是障碍物的问题。

sentences.en: Even barreling down the highway at top speed is a problem.
sentences.zh: 甚至在高速公路上全速狂飙也是个问题。

sentences.en: Cars were tuned to be most efficient around 55 to 60.
sentences.zh: 汽车被调校为在时速55到60英里时效率最高。

sentences.en: That's the speed the government used to test for fuel efficiency.
sentences.zh: 那是政府过去用来测试燃油效率的速度。

sentences.en: So they were essentially designed to be less efficient at the speeds that we really drive them
sentences.zh: 所以它们本质上的设计，反而在我们真正驾驶它们的速度下效率较低，

sentences.en: because we really drive around 65 to 70.
sentences.zh: 因为我们实际开车时速大约在65到70英里。

sentences.en: It's as if some evil genius designed a system so that we will waste gasoline.
sentences.zh: 这就像是某个邪恶的天才设计了一套系统，好让我们浪费汽油。

sentences.en: How evil is this?
sentences.zh: 这有多邪恶？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's much more banal than evil.
sentences.zh: 比起邪恶，这其实更加平庸。

sentences.en: If someone sat down to consciously design this thing,
sentences.zh: 如果有人坐下来有意识地设计这玩意儿，

sentences.en: I don't know that they could do such a good job of making a mess of things.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们能不能把事情搞得这么一团糟。

sentences.en: It's the tyranny of the lack of design.
sentences.zh: 这就是缺乏设计的暴政。

sentences.en: The tragedy of building a bad idea on a thoughtless notion, on a careless plan.
sentences.zh: 这是在一个轻率的想法、一个粗心的计划之上建立一个糟糕创意的悲剧。

sentences.en: Another dumb thing piles onto another dumb thing.
sentences.zh: 一个蠢主意叠加着另一个蠢主意。

sentences.en: And pretty soon we've got just a huge tangle of dumb,
sentences.zh: 很快我们就陷入了一团巨大的愚蠢之中，

sentences.en: all based on buying gasoline fairly cheaply.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都建立在以相当低廉的价格购买汽油的基础之上。

sentences.en: And speaking of buying gasoline cheaply, there is something designed, actually designed,
sentences.zh: 说到廉价购买汽油，确实有某种东西经过了专门设计，真正的设计，

sentences.en: to make you more comfortable with all of this when you buy gas.
sentences.zh: 目的就是为了让你在买油时对这一切感到更加安心。

sentences.en: We don't like to be in gas stations.
sentences.zh: 我们不喜欢呆在加油站里。

sentences.en: We feel like they're dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得它们很危险。

sentences.en: And we don't like to be paying money for gasoline to the oil companies.
sentences.zh: 我们也不喜欢把钱付给石油公司买汽油。

sentences.en: And we always feel that gas is too expensive no matter what the price is.
sentences.zh: 而且不管价格如何，我们总是觉得汽油太贵了。

sentences.en: So gas pumps have been specifically designed to sort of diffuse that anger.
sentences.zh: 所以加油机经过了专门设计，用来化解这种愤怒。

sentences.en: So they did some market research, and they found that people have warm feelings towards ATM machines,
sentences.zh: 因此他们做了一些市场调研，发现人们对自动取款机（ATM）有好感，

sentences.en: and they had bad feelings towards gas pumps.
sentences.zh: 而对加油机则有反感。

sentences.en: So they redesigned the gas pumps to look a little bit more like ATM machines,
sentences.zh: 于是他们重新设计了加油机，使其看起来更像ATM机，

sentences.en: so you felt like you were having sort of an intimate, warm experience when you were at the gas pump,
sentences.zh: 这样当你在加油机旁时，你会觉得有一种亲密、温暖的体验，

sentences.en: as opposed to thinking about hating the oil companies.
sentences.zh: 而不是去想自己有多讨厌石油公司。

sentences.en: Because we want an experience in tune with our values, even if what we're doing isn't.
sentences.zh: 因为我们追求一种符合我们价值观的体验，即使我们的行为并非如此。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了Lunar的支持。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 这是KALW、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会

sentences.en: and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 以及建筑与设计中心的合作项目。

sentences.en: Find out more at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
